title: Rental property (Schedule E)
description: One Schedule E Part I rental real-estate property. The expense intake offers TWO shapes and refuses to mix them on one property: `total_expenses_cents` carries the WHOLE line 20 as one amount (the itemized lines 5 through 19, depreciation included, are not asked, and the assumptions say so); or the four printed expense lines this schema itemizes (insurance, management fees, repairs, taxes) plus depreciation's own inputs (a building's depreciable basis and, separately, a 5-year MACRS personal-property item) may be entered instead — the engine computes the MACRS depreciation from those inputs, never this schema. A depreciable building's MACRS recovery PERIOD (27.5-year residential or 39-year nonresidential) is a question once its basis is answered and positive: the pinned dictionary refuses to file a rental whose basis is entered but whose class is not. For a property whose year is a loss, the two section 469/465 answers become questions (asked, never defaulted): active participation gates the Form 8582 $25,000 special allowance — a No is COMPUTED (the loss is suspended, not taken), never refused — and at-risk status decides whether the whole loss is taken or only the amount at risk is — a No opens one more question, the simplified Form 6198 amount at risk, and the loss is capped at it rather than refused. A property whose line 1b type is self-rental (type 7) opens a question of its own: material participation in the lessee business, which on a profit year moves that profit out of the passive pool.

rents_received_cents.description: Schedule E line 3, rents received. A vacancy year is a stated 0, not an absence.

total_expenses_cents.description: Schedule E line 20, total expenses — carried as one amount; the itemized lines 5 through 19 (depreciation included) are not asked. Absence is sent as zero and stated.

insurance_cents.description: Schedule E line 9, insurance. Refused beside `total_expenses_cents` on the same property — the two intakes are not combined. Absence is sent as zero and stated.

management_fees_cents.description: Schedule E line 11, management fees. Refused beside `total_expenses_cents` on the same property. Absence is sent as zero and stated.

repairs_cents.description: Schedule E line 14, repairs. Refused beside `total_expenses_cents` on the same property. Absence is sent as zero and stated.

taxes_cents.description: Schedule E line 16, taxes (real estate / property taxes on the rental). Refused beside `total_expenses_cents` on the same property. Absence is sent as zero and stated.

building_basis_cents.description: The building's depreciable basis (land already excluded), supplied directly — the building/land FMV split is not computed here. Drives the engine's own MACRS straight-line depreciation (Form 4562 Part III → Schedule E line 18); this schema never carries the computed deduction. Once this is answered and positive, `is_nonresidential_real_property` (the recovery-period class) and `building_uses_standard_gds` (the recovery-period method) become questions: the class unanswered, the pinned dictionary refuses to file the return; the method unanswered, Schedule E line 18 does not compute. Refused beside `total_expenses_cents` on the same property. Absence is sent as nothing and stated: no building depreciation is claimed for this property.

is_nonresidential_real_property.description: The building's MACRS property class: true for nonresidential real property (Form 4562 Part III §B line 19j, 39-year GDS — an office building, store, or warehouse); false for residential rental property (line 19i, 27.5-year GDS — 80% or more of the building's gross rental income is from dwelling units). A question once `building_basis_cents` is answered and positive, and only there: supplying it without a positive building basis is refused rather than dropped. Unanswered beside a positive building basis, the pinned dictionary refuses to file the return rather than assume a class (`prepare_return` asks this as a gap first).

building_uses_standard_gds.description: Whether the building is depreciated under regular MACRS GDS over one of the two recovery periods the engine computes: 27.5 years (residential rental property, Form 4562 Part III §B line 19i) or 39 years (nonresidential real property, line 19j). False for any other period or method — the pre-May-13-1993 31.5-year class, 15-year land improvements, ADS, or other class-life property; a false keeps the computed figures but the pinned dictionary refuses to file the return (its own knockout). It does not choose between 27.5 and 39 years; `is_nonresidential_real_property` does. A question once `building_basis_cents` is answered and positive, and only there: supplying it without a positive building basis is refused rather than dropped. Unanswered beside a positive building basis, Schedule E line 18 does not compute (`prepare_return` asks this as a gap first).

placed_in_service_in_current_year.description: True when the building was placed in service during the current tax year, which engages the MACRS mid-month convention first-year proration (Form 4562 Part III §B line 19i or 19j). False or absent means the building was placed in service in a prior year and this year is a full straight-line recovery year. Absence is sent as nothing and stated: the building was not placed in service this year.

placed_in_service_month.description: The calendar month (1 = January … 12 = December) the building was placed in service, selecting the first-year mid-month depreciation fraction. A question once `placed_in_service_in_current_year` is true, and only there: supplying it otherwise is refused rather than dropped.

has_five_year_property.description: True when the rental activity has a 5-year MACRS personal-property item (an appliance, carpeting, or furniture) placed in service during the current tax year (Form 4562 Part III §B line 19b). The engine computes its own first-year depreciation from `five_year_property_basis_cents`; this schema never carries the computed deduction. Absence is sent as nothing and stated: no 5-year property is claimed for this property.

five_year_property_basis_cents.description: The depreciable cost (unadjusted basis) of the 5-year MACRS personal-property item (Form 4562 Part III §B line 19b, column (c)). A question once `has_five_year_property` is true, and only there: supplying it otherwise is refused rather than dropped.

property_type.description: Schedule E line 1b type of property, as the form's own list numbers it. `self_rental` is line 1b type 7, and it is the answer that tells this service the property is rented to a trade or business the filer owns an interest in (Reg. 1.469-2(f)(6)): no separate flag is asked, so the code and the treatment cannot disagree. Answering it opens one more question, whether the filer materially participates in that lessee business, and on a property whose year is a profit the two together move the profit out of the passive pool. Absence is sent as nothing and stated: the property is not treated as a self-rental.

materially_participates_in_lessee.description: Material participation (IRC 469(c)(1) and (h)) in the trade or business this property is rented to — the LESSEE business, not the rental itself, and not the same answer as a Schedule K-1's material-participation box. Asked on a self-rental (Schedule E line 1b type 7) whose net for the year, after any prior years' unallowed loss, is a profit, and only there: on a property that is not a self-rental, supplying it is refused rather than dropped. True moves that profit out of the passive pool (Reg. 1.469-2(f)(6), Form 8582's recharacterization of rental income from property rented to a nonpassive activity), where it can no longer be sheltered by another property's passive loss; false leaves the ordinary passive path. The rule is asymmetric — a self-rental LOSS is never recharacterized — so on a loss year the answer changes no line.

active_participation.description: Section 469(i) active participation in this rental. Asked when the year's net (after any prior unallowed loss) is a loss: true opens the Form 8582 $25,000 special allowance; false suspends the loss — computed, not refused.

fully_at_risk.description: All investment in this rental is at risk (IRC 465). Asked when the current year is a loss: true takes the loss in full; false opens one more question beside it — the simplified Form 6198 amount at risk — and the loss is capped at that amount (Form 6198 line 21) rather than refused.

amount_at_risk_cents.description: Amount at risk in this rental (IRC 465) — the simplified Form 6198 Part II line 10b figure: the adjusted basis in the activity on the first day of the year, plus increases, less decreases, entered as not less than zero. The year's loss is then deducted only up to it (Form 6198 line 21) and the rest carries forward. Asked on EVERY rental whose year is a loss and whose investment is not all at risk, and only there: with all investment at risk, before that answer is given, or on a property with no loss for the year, supplying it is refused rather than dropped — the dictionary reads this figure only when the at-risk answer is present and false, and only a loss reaches the cap. NOT MODELED: the line-by-line Part II build and the detailed Part III of Form 6198, and the mid-year changes Part I covers; this is the single supplied figure the pinned dictionary carries.

prior_year_unallowed_loss_cents.description: Form 8582 Part IV column (c): prior years' unallowed passive loss for this property, from last year's Form 8582, entered as a positive amount. Once this is above zero and `active_participation` is true, `active_participation_when_loss_arose` becomes a question. Absence is sent as nothing and stated: no prior-year unallowed loss.

active_participation_when_loss_arose.description: Section 469(i) active participation in this rental in the year (or years) the prior years' unallowed loss arose. A prior-year loss stays in Form 8582 Part IV (the rental real estate special allowance) only when the filer actively participated both in the year it arose and in 2025; false moves it to Part V with the other passive activities (2025 Instructions for Form 8582, Part IV column (c)). If the loss arose over several years with different answers, answer false. A question once `prior_year_unallowed_loss_cents` is above zero and `active_participation` is true, and only there: supplying it anywhere else is refused rather than dropped. Unanswered on that population, the pinned dictionary leaves the rental's Form 8582 figures and every total they feed incomplete (`prepare_return` asks this as a gap first).
